response.sql: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), total_accounts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account), shares AS (SELECT ac.district_id, ac.account_count, CAST(ac.account_count AS FLOAT) / ta.total as share FROM account_counts ac CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), with_diff AS (SELECT s.district_id, s.account_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share as diff FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, diff FROM with_diff ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
